scope: Recovery from stalled application reads and realtime connection lifecycle; no financial or inventory write changes.

productionEvidence.interpretation: SSE failures and unbounded response-body waits are confirmed defects. These measurements do not establish a single cause for every customer-reported freeze; external catalog API latency remains a separate investigation.

changes: Bound the entire response including its body: 12 seconds for interactive POS/catalog queries and 30 seconds for other tRPC GET reads.
Isolate products.list from unrelated batched requests. Cancel superseded POS catalog searches.
Show the shared localized error/retry component on all three POS catalog layouts; avoid misleading empty results on errors.
Prevent an automatic repeat of a full timeout while retaining the existing retry for other transient reads.
Send SSE initial bytes immediately and rotate cleanly after 240 seconds, before the platform 300-second deadline.
Release SSE timers, listeners and subscriptions on every close path. Catch asynchronous delivery failures.
Reject events from other organizations before querying current user permissions. Revalidate permissions for every event eligible for delivery.

broadUnitRun.failure: local-runtime busy-port test exceeded 5 seconds during concurrent compilation and disk pressure. The complete file was rerun separately: all 20 tests passed.

isolatedDatabaseTests.infrastructure: Disposable PostgreSQL on 127.0.0.1:55459, Redis on 127.0.0.1:56409. No customer database writes.

verification.receiptSession: 24 sequential receipts with search and barcode lookup before each, repeated confirmation on every fifth receipt: 24 unique completed orders and stock 100 → 76.
verification.productionBuild: Passed in an isolated application copy: 128 pages. Temporary compiler settings: one CPU, no webpack disk cache, inline lint/typecheck disabled because both ran separately. Shipping next.config.mjs unchanged; standard CI remains mandatory.
verification.browser: Desktop 1280×720 and mobile 390×844: deliberately stalled products.list response body. Error/retry appeared after deadline; after restoring the connection, explicit retry displayed the matching product. Both stalled connections were cancelled. A superseded stalled search was also cancelled, and a subsequent different search displayed its matching product; no console errors.
verification.releaseStatus: Local verification record. Production deployment and standard CI must be checked for the resulting commit.

rollback: No schema migration. Previous application deployment remains compatible with the database.
